Volvo Penta sterndrive and diesel service in Tampa Bay

Volvo Penta gas sterndrives and small diesels are common on cruisers and sailboats in St. Petersburg, Clearwater, and Tampa marinas. Volvo-certified mechanics in the network service both.

Models we see most

SX and DPS gas drives, D3 through D6 diesels, IPS pods on larger yachts

Service intervals

Annual service; drive bellows and oil per schedule; diesel fuel filters and raw-water impellers annually; aftercooler and heat exchanger cleaning on diesels at interval.

Parts and diagnostics

Parts are available but priced like Volvo. Diagnostics require Volvo's VODIA tool, which the certified mechanics carry.

What goes wrong on Volvo Pentas around here

  • Bellows and drive seals on SX/DPS
  • Raw-water pump and heat exchanger fouling
  • Injector and fuel issues on D-series diesels
  • Electronic throttle and EVC faults
  • Exhaust elbow corrosion

Services for Volvo Penta

Inboard and sterndrive$500 to $1,200 for annual serviceMarine diesel$600 to $1,500 for service

Questions we get

Can a mobile mechanic read Volvo EVC codes?

Yes if they carry VODIA. Tell us it is a Volvo and we match accordingly.
